authority: Same-context analysis. No scientific or promotion authority.
object: The scientific decomposition and headline question of Paper IV.
current_question: Does learner-conditioned vector structural allocation over the same directional/QoI/boundary structural substrate used at inference improve training efficiency and fresh transfer beyond Static Structural and strongest adaptive parents?
problem_with_current_question: It conflates whether the structural state contains incremental predictive information with whether one allocator uses that information well.
It bundles a third claim - exact train-to-inference structural identity reuse - whose truth is not implied by an allocation win.
A negative Adaptive-vs-Static policy result can occur even when the state representation is useful; the known-world structure-identity collapse counterexample on PR #708 is a concrete witness.
The corrected Phase-1 v2 evidence is heterogeneous: one 7B family has MECHANISM_SIGNAL_PRESENT while other family/model cells are repetition-valued, null-residual or model-floor terminals.

candidate_questions.question: Does the checkpoint-bound typed structural learner state contain incremental predictive information about the vector of future transfer gain/harm from a candidate exposure beyond loss, gradient/influence and strongest skill-state parents?
candidate_questions.why: Separates representation/information sufficiency from control-policy quality. A null directly narrows the RAKL residual without blaming the allocator.
candidate_questions.primary_outcome: fresh/cross-fitted prediction of next-exposure gain/harm vector with calibration/proper scoring and total probe cost

candidate_questions.question: Conditional on any incremental structural information, can a registered allocation policy turn it into better fresh transfer per total cost than Static Structural and the strongest adaptive parent without crossing composition, boundary, retention or negative-transfer harm gates?
candidate_questions.why: A policy can fail even when Q1 is positive; this localizes a negative to the decision rule instead of the representation.
candidate_questions.primary_outcome: paired fresh decision utility/cost vector under matched compute
candidate_questions.existing_evidence_lane: Frozen five-arm 7B Phase-2 Adaptive-v1 experiment addresses one policy instance and must remain unchanged.

candidate_questions.question: Does the exact structural identity that is predictive/useful for training allocation also reduce inference-time transfer or re-derivation cost on fresh structure-known/domain-new tasks?
candidate_questions.why: Tests the claimed unification directly rather than inferring it from training performance.
candidate_questions.primary_outcome: fresh exact-identity reuse advantage with stale-reuse error hard-gated at zero

candidate_questions.question: Which structural coordinates are causally necessary for the information/decision residual, and where are simpler skill/influence representations sufficient?
candidate_questions.why: Prevents the six-coordinate representation from becoming architecture accumulation; removes coordinates that add no fresh residual.

recommended_headline_question.statement: When is a checkpoint-bound typed structural state a decision-useful representation of what a learner should see next? First test whether it predicts future transfer gain/harm beyond strong learner-state/influence parents; only then test whether a policy can convert that information into a noncompensatory fresh-transfer/cost benefit.
recommended_headline_question.paper_title_direction: Structural Learning Mechanics: When Typed Structural State Is Predictive and Actionable for Training
recommended_headline_question.why_better: It survives both policy-positive and policy-negative outcomes, makes the strongest-parent residual explicit, and prevents a bad allocator from falsifying a useful representation or a good allocator from laundering a non-novel state representation.

identity_question_position: Q3 is a co-primary unification claim only after Q1 or Q2 earns a positive residual; otherwise it remains a separate architectural reuse question.

publication_branching.Q1_negative: Learner-conditioned structural state has no incremental information residual at tested scope; do not sell adaptive structural mechanics as distinct. Preserve static/inference structural mechanics separately.
publication_branching.Q1_positive_Q2_negative: Publishable information result may remain, but allocator mechanism is unsupported; build successors only from frozen diagnosis, not by tuning same outcomes.
publication_branching.Q1_positive_Q2_positive_Q3_negative: Structural state is predictive/actionable but train/inference unification is false; report two representations/mechanisms.
publication_branching.Q1_Q2_Q3_positive: Strong standalone Structural Learning Mechanics result; proceed to cross-family/model applicability law.

must_not_claim: A broad structural-learning law from the single 7B state_reachability signal.
That Adaptive-v1 is evidence about every possible structural allocator.
That a training win establishes exact inference identity reuse.
